roadmap.goal: Fix the pi-kata commit-gate timing defect (RCA: GitCommitVerifier cannot pass at a pre-commit tool_call; COMMIT phase recorded post-commit). Settled design: LIVE gate = phase-completeness at the pre-commit tool_call (suppress cwd + drop PROJECT-ROOT marker so the engine skips GitCommitVerifier; record COMMIT before git commit); commit-trailer PROVENANCE moves to a mandatory post-hoc check reusing GitCommitVerifier unchanged. Zero src/des change.

steps.name: Phase-completeness-only live gate (pre-commit) + COMMIT-before-commit ordering
steps.scenario_name: Bug regression: pre-commit gate allows a complete cycle without a COMMIT_NOT_VERIFIED no-commits-yet failure and blocks an incomplete one
criteria: RED live-faithful regression: validate at PRE-commit order (NO commit yet); a complete RED+GREEN+COMMIT cycle ALLOWs with NO COMMIT_NOT_VERIFIED / 'no commits yet'; an incomplete cycle BLOCKs on missing phases

transcript_context gains a phase-completeness-only mode: omit DES-PROJECT-ROOT marker (KEEP VALIDATION+PROJECT-ID+STEP-ID) and omit cwd from the subagent-stop payload so the engine skips GitCommitVerifier (R1: must still be a genuine DES validation, not non-DES passthrough)
extension commit-context branch (pi-des-extension.ts.template) uses the phase-completeness-only payload at the pre-commit tool_call; comment updated
crafter skill (_CRAFTER_SKILL_SECTION) reordered to record the COMMIT phase BEFORE git commit; provenance prose rewritten (live=phase-completeness, trailer=post-hoc)
ZERO src/des change; pi_kata + pi_harness suites stay green
steps.implementation_notes: RCA branches A+B+C. Confirm phase-only validation still emits SUBAGENT_STOP_PASSED/FAILED (not passthrough). The relative execution-log resolution must still find the log via process-cwd=project-root (R2).

steps.name: Post-hoc commit-trailer provenance check (reuse GitCommitVerifier)
steps.scenario_name: Bug regression: post-hoc provenance verifies every recorded-COMMIT step has a matching Step-Id+Task-Id commit and flags a recorded-but-not-committed step
criteria: RED: a post-hoc provenance check (new scripts/install/pi_kata/provenance.py reusing the UNCHANGED GitCommitVerifier) PASSes when every recorded-COMMIT step has a matching Step-Id+Task-Id commit, and FAILs (flags) a step that recorded COMMIT but never committed / wrong trailers (closes R3)
ADR-pkt-001 D-PKT-4 amended: live=phase-completeness at pre-commit tool_call; commit-trailer provenance=post-hoc (supersede note)
steps.implementation_notes: R3 mitigation is mandatory: the live gate no longer verifies the commit happened, so the post-hoc check is the provenance backstop. Reuse GitCommitVerifier unchanged.
